topic.label: Time
topic.desc: When something happens: clocks, time zones and timestamps, calendars and scheduling, durations and deadlines, and ordering of events.

concepts: Current time, UTC and local time, IANA time zones, daylight saving, timestamp formats and conversion.
Calendars, recurring events, business days, holidays and scheduling across people and time zones.
Elapsed time, deadlines, intervals, time to live and how durations are measured and stated.
Ordering events in time: timelines, causality, clocks across machines, logical and vector clocks.
skills: Converts a time between time zones, accounting for daylight saving, and states the UTC offset used.
Normalizes timestamps in mixed formats to ISO 8601 UTC and flags ambiguous ones.
Finds meeting times that fit participants in several time zones, avoiding holidays and outside working hours.
Computes business days between dates for a country's holiday calendar.
Computes time remaining to deadlines and flags those at risk.
Checks whether time intervals overlap and reports the overlap.
Builds a timeline from dated events and marks gaps and conflicting dates.
Explains how events from different machines are ordered (timestamps, logical clocks) and where order is uncertain.
mcp: Time reference MCP server: current time in any IANA time zone and conversion between time zones.
